Long warm brown ponytail, elegant attractive adult face, teal industrial utility jacket over cream high-neck shirt, dark practical shorts, sturdy brown boots, brass tool belt, wrench. Feminine adult silhouette with modest professional practical clothing..
Art: fine detailed Korean/Japanese RPG pixel art, hard square pixel edges, dark pixel outline, stepped limited-palette shading, elegant mature face. Tiny sprites 3.5 heads high. All faces adult. EXACT PAGE PLAN:
LEFT 512px WIDTH: a single thigh-up detailed pixel character portrait, entirely contained within x24..488 and y24..1000; head/hair fully visible.
RIGHT 1024px WIDTH: EXACTLY SIXTY-FOUR small complete full-body sprites in an invisible EIGHT-COLUMN by EIGHT-ROW evenly spaced grid. Grid covers x512..1535,y0..1023; each cell128x128. Eight rows, eight sprites per row. DO NOT omit row5/full back. DO NOT add a ninth column.
Each row is a genuine different 45-degree rotation, all eight actions in that row maintain that direction:
ROW1: south FRONT direct frontal face and chest.
ROW2: southwest FRONT-LEFT diagonal.
ROW3: west LEFT strict profile.
ROW4: northwest BACK-LEFT diagonal.
ROW5: north BACK full rear, only back of head, face fully invisible.
ROW6: northeast BACK-RIGHT diagonal.
ROW7: east RIGHT strict profile.
ROW8: southeast FRONT-RIGHT diagonal.
Exactly eight columns of actions, consistent across all eight rows:
COLUMN1 idle.
COLUMN2 walk left-foot forward/right-arm forward.
COLUMN3 walk passing feet together.
COLUMN4 walk right-foot forward/left-arm forward.
COLUMN5 carry wooden box left-foot forward.
COLUMN6 carry wooden box right-foot forward.
COLUMN7 work with metal wrench raised overhead.
COLUMN8 work with same metal wrench thrust downward/forward in impact, clearly different pose.
No extra idle column. No extra sprites outside grid. Actual front/back/left/right anatomy and garment changes required; no repeated facing. All eight directions, including BOTH diagonal-back views and straight-back view, are mandatory.
Transparent backdrop, truly alpha-transparent gaps, no painted background. NO labels, letters, numbers, text, grid lines, scenery or ground shadows. One portrait on left + exact 8 rows ×8 columns on right.
